description: The picture on a new canvas: a gradient, a colour or another picture behind it. Takes image files.

blur.description: How much that picture is blurred, in percent of the longer side of the photo.

corners.description: Corner radius, in percent of the longer side.

gradient.description: One of the nine gradients, 1 to 9 (the default fill is gradient 1).

image.description: Another picture instead, scaled to cover the canvas.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

padding.description: Space around the photo, in percent of its longer side.

ratio.description: The canvas shape, width:height such as `4:5`; the photo plus padding when left out.

shadow.description: Shadow softness, in percent of the longer side (0: none).

name: image_frame
title: Put on a background
